subject: how to use index.rhtml instead of index.html as default starting page

messages.author: 066a0ceb2819d0e3
messages.subject: how to use index.rhtml instead of index.html as default starting page
parts:
Maybe this is an apache question instead of an rapache question, but I
would like to have rapache serve up index.rhtml instead of
index.html.

I have added the following two lines to the httpd.conf file to try to
get it to show index.rhtml.

AddType text/html .rhtml

DirectoryIndex index.rhtml

It does serve the file, but the browser doesn't know how to open it,
it asks if I want to save the file. The "brew" part works file
because if I give it localhost/index.rhtml it shows the page fine.
But just "localhost" it will ask me if I want to save the file. Any
ideas?

Thanks,

Roger

messages.author: 3ea57457192f4f3b
messages.subject: Re: how to use index.rhtml instead of index.html as default starting  page
parts: The problem is a problem in IE, not Apache. My advice: don't use the .rhtml extension. You don't need it and it confuses IE in a way that it will think it has to download the file instead of display it. Best way to name your rapache scripts is either matching the extention with the content type (e.g. 'html', or 'png' if an image is returned) or what I usually do not giving them an extension at all. Works for all browsers.
